lenses.name: Solar capacity
lenses.description: Installed solar-electric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Commune capacities are aggregated by map hex; small installations are represented through ODRÉ commune aggregates.

lenses.name: Wind capacity
lenses.description: Installed wind-electric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Commune capacities are aggregated by map hex.

lenses.name: Hydro capacity
lenses.description: Installed hydroelectric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry, including conventional, run-of-river, pumped-storage and tidal installations where present. Commune capacities are aggregated by map hex.

lenses.name: Nuclear capacity
lenses.description: Installed nuclear-electric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Per-capita normalization is only a spatial intensity measure: electricity is transmitted nationally rather than consumed solely by nearby residents.

lenses.name: Renewable capacity
lenses.description: Installed renewable-electric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Hydro includes pumped-storage and tidal installations where present, so the total is generation-capacity infrastructure rather than a strict annual renewable-generation measure.

lenses.name: Non-hydro storage
lenses.description: Installed non-hydraulic electricity-storage power per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Values use the registry's maximum installed power field; energy duration in MWh is not available in this national extract.
